- **RL Impact**: RL models may dynamically adjust task prioritization (e.g., prioritize decode workers with higher latency) or allocate tasks based on real-time feedback to optimize scheduling efficiency.

- **RL Impact**: RL-based policies may prioritize workers with higher cache hit rates or optimize cache coalescing to balance between speed and memory usage.
